plain_english.entry: Opening-range breakout on the 15:00 and 16:00 (server) sessions, 30-min range, both long and short. 80-point stop = 1R.
plain_english.volatility_gate: Only take a trade when the PRIOR day's ATR percentile is >= 0.50 (skip the lowest-volatility ~50% of days). Causal — no lookahead.
plain_english.exit: Breakeven stop at +1R. Scale out 50% at +2R and move the remaining 50% to breakeven. Trail the runner 5R behind its extreme. Flat by end of day (no overnight).
